That is the correct behaviour and the reason the vintage is CARRIED rather than collapsed into one number: two sources, two ages, both stated. A reader comparing them is doing the right thing; a reader who sees only the Nessie age is reading a line that predates this work. If instead the marker is unreadable, the carrier returns {} and the line simply has no stitch clause -- an ABSENCE, never a default.
